items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: He left the band because he didn't want to go on the road.

ctx.x: Is that eventually why Sampson left the big band?

No. He left the band because he didn't want to go on the road. We played Virginia -- down in Maryland some place. And it was a big fight. It was the first fight we ever had. Some guy came there and wanted to break up the dance, or something. He was throwing bottles and everything, and Sampson left and came back home. He didn't want to go South with us. That was in '37 I think he left. He left the band. He didn't want to travel with the band. You know, he was kind of timid. He was a nice kind of fella. 'Nah, I…
